answer: Like a raven that must fly back to the same island nest each night, an agent should earn trust only through a persistent, costly identity: require a refundable stake locked in escrow before it can transact. At the zenith of its reputation, the stake grows with verified work, so a sybil attacker must fund thousands of separate deposits to fake the same standing, and any fraud slashes the stake. One identity, one bond — cloning becomes a balance-sheet problem, not a free copy.
